name: seal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
p=Path.cwd(); exclusions=['hash-manifest.json','seal_manifest.receipt.json','seal_manifest.output.txt'];rows=[]
for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if not f.is_file():continue
 n=str(f.relative_to(p))
 if n in exclusions:continue
 b=f.read_bytes();rows.append({'path':n,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
manifest={'target':378413,'files':rows,'terminal_noncircular_exclusions':exclusions,'frozen_after':json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text()),'credit':0,'note':'Every own file present before terminal sealing, including every completed receipt, frozen helper/input, payload, plan, full response, ledger and render; terminal receipt/output produced by immutable runner after this manifest.'}
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'hash-manifest.json'],input=json.dumps(manifest,indent=2),text=True,check=True)
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files':len(rows),'frozen_mismatches':manifest['frozen_after'].get('mismatches'),'terminal_exclusions':exclusions,'credit':0}))
